searchLog: Checked data/target-companies.json against life/PIPELINE.md (Stripe, IBM x6, Capital One, Robinhood, Disney, Notion BDR, Claude Corps, Anthropic Fellows, Northslope, LSEG, Mathematica, Veeva, MATS, and ~20 others already applied-to or rejected — excluded). WebFetch suffered persistent DNS/network failures on nearly every target-company domain this run (databricks.com, scale.com, sierra.ai, metacareers.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io all returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND on every attempt, including retries) while anthropic.com fetched fine — a tool-side issue, not a proxy outage (checked __agentproxy/status: healthy, no relay failures). Anthropic's own careers index loaded but is a bare listing index with no descriptions, YOE requirements, or deadlines per role, and its Applied AI Architect / Forward Deployed Engineer reqs are all mid/senior with no new-grad track (consistent with target-companies.json's note); Anthropic Fellows and Claude Corps are already rejected per PIPELINE.md. Candidates surfaced only via WebSearch snippet (Databricks APM New Grad 2027 start, Scale AI Strategic Projects Lead New Grad, Sierra APX 2027 cohort) could not be confirmed open-now/eligible by loading the actual application page as hunt.md requires, and snippets themselves were inconsistent or stale (Scale AI's own page showed 'no open roles match' for the new-grad track; Sierra's third-party eligibility estimate skewed toward spring/summer 2027 grads, not Dom's Dec-2026 window). Rather than include anything on snippet strength alone, reporting zero verified opportunities this run — see final report for the network-failure detail and recommendation to re-run the hunt once WebFetch connectivity to job boards recovers.
